request.query: d belongs to the finite box of finitely supported natural multiindices iff every coordinate d i ≤ r i

content.text:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "formal_name": "Behrend.mem_box",
      "informal_name": "Membership in Behrend's Box",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {n d : ℕ} {x : Fin n → ℕ}, x ∈ Behrend.box n d ↔ ∀ (i : Fin n), x i < d",
      "informal_description": "An element $ x $ is in Behrend's box $ \\text{box}(n, d) $ if and only if every coordinate $ x_i $ satisfies $ x_i < d $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Combinatorics.Additive.AP.Three.Behrend"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "BoxIntegral.Box.instMembershipForallReal",
      "informal_name": "Membership in Boxes via Left-Open Right-Closed Intervals",
      "kind": "instance",
      "type": "{ι : Type u_1} → Membership (ι → ℝ) (BoxIntegral.Box ι)",
      "informal_description": "For any box $ B $ in $ n $-dimensional space and a point $ x $, $ x $ is in $ B $ if and only if for every coordinate $ i $, the $ i $-th component of $ x $ lies in the left-open right-closed interval $ (B.\text{lower}(i), B.\text{upper}(i)] $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.BoxIntegral.Box.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "Behrend.box",
      "informal_name": "Behrend's box",
      "kind": "definition",
      "type": "(n : ℕ) → ℕ → Finset (Fin n → ℕ)",
      "informal_description": "The finite set of all functions from $\\{0, 1, \\ldots, n-1\\}$ to $\\{0, 1, \\ldots, d-1\\}$, i.e., the set of $n$-tuples where each coordinate is an integer between $0$ and $d-1$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Combinatorics.Additive.AP.Three.Behrend"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "BoxIntegral.Box.upper_mem",
      "informal_name": "Upper Bound Point in Box",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} (I : BoxIntegral.Box ι), I.upper ∈ I",
      "informal_description": "For any box $ I $ in $ n $-dimensional space, the point whose $ i $-th coordinate equals the upper bound of $ I $ along the $ i $-th axis is an element of $ I $.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.BoxIntegral.Box.Basic"
    },
    {
      "formal_name": "BoxIntegral.unitPartition.mem_admissibleIndex_iff",
      "informal_name": "Admissible Index Membership iff Unit Partition Box is Contained",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {ι : Type u_1} {n : ℕ} [inst : NeZero n] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] {B : BoxIntegral.Box ι} {ν : ι → ℤ},\n  ν ∈ BoxIntegral.unitPartition.admissibleIndex n B ↔ BoxIntegral.unitPartition.box n ν ≤ B",
      "informal_description": "A function $\\nu : \\iota \\to \\mathbb{Z}$ belongs to the admissible index set for a box $B$ and positive integer $n$ if and only if the unit partition box $\\prod_{i \\in \\iota} \\left[ \\frac{\\nu(i)}{n}, \\frac{\\nu(i)+1}{n} \\right]$ is contained within $B$.",
      "path": "Mathlib.Analysis.BoxIntegral.UnitPartition"
    }
  ]
}
